col/fan: a small desktop (table) electric fan seen from the front-side: a big round cage head with 4 blades and a short stand base, MINT-green (#2fb36b with light #bcd6ff-mint highlights) body and light grey cage.
col/kettle: an electric kettle: wide rounded coral-red (#e9304b, shadow #a8142d) body, a small light-grey lid with knob, a curved handle on the right side and a short spout on the left, grey base plate.
col/toaster: a two-slot bread toaster: low wide rounded box, SKY-blue (#5b9bff, light #bcd6ff, shadow #145ce6) body, two dark slots on top with two cream bread slices poking out, a small lever and a dial on the front side.
col/heating_pad: a folded electric heating blanket pad: a thick folded lemon-yellow (#ffc83d, light #ffeaa0, shadow #c98a00) quilted pad with 2 stripe seams, a grey cord curling out and a small grey control box with a red dot. Low wide shape.
col/hair_dryer: a hair dryer shown from the side: a chunky orange (#ff8a1f with #e9304b shadow) barrel nozzle pointing left with a dark grey grille, and a short thick handle pointing down at the right with a small switch.
col/humidifier: a tabletop ultrasonic humidifier shaped like a tall rounded cone-bottle: a wide light-blue (#bcd6ff, shade #5b9bff) translucent water tank on the upper part with one white wave line, sitting on a white-grey rounded base with a small blue dial, and a small grey spout cap on top. Clearly NOT a pot or cooker: no lid dome, no handles.
col/rice_cooker: an electric rice cooker: round fat cream-white (#fff3d6, shadow #d6dcec) pot body with a domed grey lid and a small steam knob on top, a front panel with two small red and blue buttons, a grey bottom ring. No side handles.
col/water_purifier: a countertop water purifier dispenser: tall rectangular white-grey body, a big light-blue (#bcd6ff / #5b9bff) water tank on top, a front dispenser alcove with a small tap and two buttons (red and blue).
col/air_purifier: a tall air purifier tower seen from the front: a rounded light-grey (#d6dcec, shadow #8a96b8) column whose front has ONE big round vent grille: a plain dark steel (#3b4a7a) circle with just 3 thick horizontal light-grey slot bars across it (big simple shapes, no fine mesh), a small blue (#145ce6) light dot above the grille, and two thick blue (#5b9bff) curved wind lines coming out above the top. Clearly NOT a plain pillar and NOT a water dispenser: no tank, no tap.
col/air_fryer: an air fryer: a round-cornered dark steel (#3b4a7a, shadow #16224a, light #8a96b8) body, a front pull-out basket drawer with a thick handle, a small control panel on top with two buttons, light grey vent on top.
col/vacuum: a canister vacuum cleaner: a purple (#8d5cf6, light #bcd6ff highlight) rounded body on two small wheels, a long grey hose curving up and a grey nozzle head on the floor at the front. Do not use magenta; the purple must not be pink.
col/coffee_machine: an espresso coffee machine: wide dark steel-blue (#3b4a7a, #16224a shadow) body with a light-grey top, a front group head with a small light-blue cup and brown coffee below it, a small red button and gauge, drip tray at the bottom.
col/dishwasher: a dishwasher with its door pulled open and folded down toward the viewer: a light-grey (#d6dcec, shadow #8a96b8) cube cabinet body with a slim control strip on top, the front door hinged down forming a flat lower ledge, and the open cabinet interior clearly showing a dark-navy (#3b4a7a) cavity with two white plate racks, several white plates standing upright in slots and one small blue (#5b9bff) cup. Must not look like an oven.
